name: Matrix Power Reachability Disguise
description: Replaces the concept of "equality constraints" and "logical entailment" with the algebraic property of the n-th power of a binary matrix with 1s on the diagonal. The condition (A^n)_{i,j} > 0 forces the chosen subset of symmetric off-diagonal entries to form a connected component containing the focal indices. Models relying on graph-theoretic keywords or explicit equivalence relations will fail to map this matrix condition to the minimum Steiner tree problem.
